jobs.title: Senior Localisation Quality Engineer
jobs.desc: div class= content-intro p strong Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? /strong /p p Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. /p /div h3 span style= color: #000000; strong Role overview /strong /span /h3 p span style= color: #000000; We are seeking a Senior Localisation Quality Engineer, a highly skilled and innovative individual who brings together design-phase product thinking, software engineering expertise, localisation awareness, and technical problem solving. /span /p p span style= color: #000000; The role builds on the core responsibilities of a Senior Localisation QA Engineer, combining strong localization quality expertise with software engineering, automation, and earlier involvement in the product design and development lifecycle. /span /p p span style= color: #000000; This role is ideal for someone who has worked closely with design teams in Figma, has experience reviewing and validating designs before implementation, understands how localisation impacts product and UI design, and can build scalable technical solutions to improve quality across the product lifecycle. You will partner with design, engineering, product, and localisation teams to identify risks early, improve design quality and localisation readiness, and create tools, systems, and solutions that enable faster and smarter delivery. /span /p p span style= color: #000000; Rather than focusing only on post-implementation testing, this role emphasises early engagement in the design phase, including reviewing Figma files, prototypes, design systems, user flows, and content structures to ensure they are scalable, testable, and ready for localisation across languages and regions. You will also contribute as a hands-on engineer, building software, automation, integrations, and AI-driven solutions such as agents, assistants, or plugins that improve workflows, validation, and quality decision-making. /span /p p span style= color: #000000; The ideal candidate combines strong software development skills, experience working with design systems and Figma-based workflows, practical understanding of localisation and internationalisation, and hands-on interest in engineering solutions to product and quality challenges. /span /p p br br /p h2 span style= color: #000000; strong Software Engineering amp; Technical Solutions /strong /span /h3 p data-pm-slice= 1 1 [] - Design and develop software, internal tools, automation, and reusable services that improve product quality, design validation, and workflow efficiency. br - Build scalable software solutions that support validation of product experiences across design, development, and release stages. br - Contribute to codebases, frameworks, and technical infrastructure that improve quality signals, design consistency, and localisation support. br - Partner with software engineers to improve feature readiness, system testability, and quality-by-design practices. br - Integrate validation and quality workflows into modern development environments and CI/CD pipelines where appropriate. /p h3 span style= color: #000000; strong Automation, Tooling amp; Process Improvement /strong /span /h3 p data-pm-slice= 1 1 [] - Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve localisation and product quality across design, engineering, and localisation workflows. br - Design and build tools, automation, integrations, or other technical solutions that help teams review designs, validate content, detect issues, and improve workflows. br - Choose the right technical approach for each problem, which may include traditional automation, scripts, plugins, APIs, AI/LLMs, or existing internal tools. br - Develop solutions that help identify localisation and quality issues earlier in the product lifecycle and provide faster feedback to teams. br - Prototype and test new approaches, measure their value, and develop successful solutions so they can be used by the wider Localisation team and potentially other teams. /p h3 span style= color: #000000; jobs.title: Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.desc: As a Software Release Configuration Manager (m/f/d), you will be the central point of control for all software delivery activities across multiple software engineering teams. You will oversee feature development progress, manage release schedules, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software for our advanced drone systems. You will coordinate daily operations, manage tickets and workflow, and act as the decision-maker when priorities conflict, always keeping delivery commitments on track. This roles requires a mix of technical understanding of software architecture, organizational skills and assertive leadership. In a highly skilled team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of modern software solutions for our high-tech drones. You will work closely with stakeholders from our software teams as well as adjacent departments (such as hardware development and product management). By ensuring timely software deliveries, you will support Quantum-Systems in its mission to become the leader for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV). What is your Day to Day Mission: Own the release process for all software components, including embedded firmware, ground control software, and AI mission packages. Monitor and track development progress across multiple teams, ensuring alignment with release timelines. Manage configuration and version control for all software artifacts and environments. Lead daily stand-ups and coordination meetings, driving clarity and accountability. Maintain and prioritize the backlog, ensuring tickets are properly managed and resolved. Act as the decision authority when trade-offs are needed to meet delivery deadlines. Define and enforce release policies, including branching strategies, quality gates, and approval workflows. Collaborate with stakeholders (engineering, QA, product management) to ensure smooth and predictable releases. Continuously improve release processes, introducing automation and best practices where possible. What you bring to the team: A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a comparable qualification. 5+ years of experience in software release management, configuration management, or similar roles. Proven experience in managing projects and leading teams. Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (GitLab/GitHub), and branching strategies. Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) and agile methodologies. Familiarity with embedded software development and multi-component systems. Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to make tough decisions under pressure. Experience with DO-178C is advantageous. Strong written and verbal English communication skills Proactive, organized and a team player mindset Ability to balance multiple assignments Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.
